source.authority: Oregon Health Authority — Prioritized List Guideline Note 39 (re-badged for demo as a Molina policy)

branches.initial: First hysterectomy request for endometriosis or adenomyosis

criteria.description: Either Section A (endometriosis pathway) or Section B (adenomyosis pathway) must be fully met.

children.description: Hysterectomy for endometriosis — all four numbered criteria must be documented.

policy_citation.quote: Hysterectomy, with or without adnexectomy, for endometriosis may be appropriate when all of the following are documented

children.description: Patient history of (a) prior operative/histologic endometriosis diagnosis AND (b) >6 months of impactful pain.
Prior detailed operative description or histologic diagnosis of endometriosis.

policy_citation.quote: Prior detailed operative description or histologic diagnosis of endometriosis

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for biopsy/pathology reports (CPT 58100 endometrial biopsy, 49321 laparoscopic biopsy) with histologic diagnosis of endometriosis; or operative notes from prior laparoscopy describing endometriotic lesions.

verdict_rubric.met: Documented prior operative description OR pathology report confirming endometriosis.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Endometriosis only suspected clinically without operative or histologic confirmation.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Imaging or symptoms suggest endometriosis but the record is ambiguous on confirmatory diagnosis.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No reference to prior operative or histologic workup for endometriosis.

children.description: Pain for more than 6 months with negative effect on patient's quality of life.

policy_citation.quote: Presence of pain for more than 6 months with negative effect on patient

evaluation.extraction_hints: Compute symptom duration from documented onset to current visit; look for QoL impact (work limitation, sleep, ADL impairment, persistent analgesic use).

verdict_rubric.met: Documented pain duration ≥6 months AND explicit QoL/functional impact statement.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pain documented for <6 months OR no QoL impact mentioned.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Pain present but duration or QoL impact ambiguous.

children.description: 3-month therapeutic trial with BOTH hormonal therapy AND NSAIDs failed (unless contraindicated).

policy_citation.quote: Failure of a 3-month therapeutic trial with both of the following

children.description: Hormonal therapy attempted for ≥3 months — either OCP/IUD-class OR amenorrhea-inducing agent.

policy_citation.quote: Hormonal therapy

children.description: Oral contraceptive pills/patches, progesterone-containing IUDs, or injectable hormone therapy tried.

policy_citation.quote: Oral contraceptive pills or patches, progesterone-containing IUDs, injectable hormone therapy, or similar

evaluation.extraction_hints: Use lookup_term_class with target_class=oral_contraceptive, progesterone_iud, or injectable_hormone. Includes Mirena/Kyleena/Liletta (IUD), DMPA/Depo-Provera (injectable), OCPs (ethinyl estradiol/norethindrone/drospirenone).

verdict_rubric.met: Documented use of OCP, progesterone IUD, or injectable hormone for ≥3 months in the current episode.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Tried for <3 months OR not tried at all.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No mention of hormonal therapy trial.

children.description: GnRH analogs or danazol (amenorrhea-inducing agents) tried for ≥3 months.

policy_citation.quote: Agents for inducing amenorrhea

evaluation.extraction_hints: Use lookup_term_class with target_class=gnrh_analog. Includes leuprolide (Lupron), nafarelin, goserelin (Zoladex), or danazol.

verdict_rubric.met: GnRH analog or danazol used for ≥3 months.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Not tried, or for shorter duration.

children.description: NSAIDs tried for ≥3 months (concurrent with hormonal therapy).

policy_citation.quote: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs

evaluation.extraction_hints: lookup_term_class with target_class=NSAID. Includes ibuprofen, naproxen, celecoxib, meloxicam, diclofenac. Duration ≥3 months for the current episode.

verdict_rubric.met: NSAID documented as used regularly for ≥3 months for endometriosis pain.
verdict_rubric.not_met: NSAID not tried or shorter duration.

children.description: Nonmalignant cervical cytology (Pap smear) if cervix is present.

policy_citation.quote: Nonmalignant cervical cytology, if cervix is present

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for recent Pap smear (CPT 88142/88175) results — should be NILM/NEGATIVE for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. Patients with prior supracervical hysterectomy (no cervix) automatically satisfy.

verdict_rubric.met: Documented Pap result negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy, OR documented absence of cervix.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pap shows malignancy or high-grade dysplasia.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Pap result mentioned but interpretation unclear.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No recent cervical cytology in record.

children.description: Negative preoperative pregnancy test (unless postmenopausal or previously sterilized).

policy_citation.quote: Negative preoperative pregnancy test result

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for hCG negative result, OR documented postmenopausal status, OR prior tubal ligation/sterilization (CPT 58600/58615/58671). Patient age > 55 usually implies postmenopausal.

verdict_rubric.met: Negative hCG OR documented postmenopausal OR documented sterilization.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Sterilization or menopausal status implied but not explicit.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No pregnancy test result and reproductive status unclear.

children.description: Hysterectomy for adenomyosis — all five numbered criteria must be documented.

policy_citation.quote: Hysterectomy, with or without adnexectomy, for adenomyosis may be appropriate when all of the following are documented

children.description: Dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain, or abnormal uterine bleeding for >6 months with QoL impact.

policy_citation.quote: Patient history of dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain or abnormal uterine bleeding for more than six months

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for ICD-10 N94.6 (dysmenorrhea), N92.* (excessive menstruation), N93.* (other abnormal uterine bleeding), or N80.03 (adenomyosis itself). Compute symptom duration ≥6 months; look for QoL impact statement.

verdict_rubric.met: Dysmenorrhea/pelvic pain/AUB documented ≥6 months AND QoL impact mentioned.

children.description: 6-month therapeutic trial with hormonal therapy AND NSAIDs failed (unless contraindicated).

policy_citation.quote: Failure of a six-month therapeutic trial with both of the following

children.description: Hormonal therapy attempted for ≥6 months — either OCP/IUD-class OR amenorrhea-inducing agent.
Oral contraceptive pills/patches, progesterone-containing IUDs, or injectable hormone therapy tried for ≥6 months.

policy_citation.quote: Oral contraceptive pills or patches, progesterone-containing IUDs, injectable hormone therapy, or similar

evaluation.extraction_hints: Use lookup_term_class oral_contraceptive/progesterone_iud/injectable_hormone. Mirena IUD insertion (CPT 58300) or DMPA injection counts. Duration ≥6 months.

verdict_rubric.met: OCP, progesterone IUD, or DMPA used for ≥6 months in the current episode.

children.description: GnRH analogs or danazol tried for ≥6 months.

policy_citation.quote: Agents for inducing amenorrhea

evaluation.extraction_hints: lookup_term_class gnrh_analog. Leuprolide, nafarelin, goserelin, danazol. Duration ≥6 months.

children.description: NSAIDs tried for ≥6 months (concurrent with hormonal therapy).

policy_citation.quote: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs

evaluation.extraction_hints: lookup_term_class NSAID. Ibuprofen, naproxen, celecoxib, meloxicam, diclofenac. Duration ≥6 months.

children.description: Imaging confirms adenomyosis — either endovaginal US OR MRI finding.
Endovaginal ultrasound suspicious for adenomyosis (abnormal hypoechoic myometrial echogenicity OR small myometrial cysts).

policy_citation.quote: abnormal hypoechoic myometrial echogenicity or presence of small myometrial cysts

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for endovaginal ultrasound report (CPT 76830). Find phrases: 'heterogeneous myometrium', 'hypoechoic', 'myometrial cysts', 'suggestive of adenomyosis', 'asymmetric myometrial thickening'.

verdict_rubric.met: US report explicitly notes hypoechoic myometrial echogenicity, myometrial cysts, or 'suggestive of adenomyosis'.
verdict_rubric.unclear: US findings ambiguous (e.g., 'heterogeneous myometrium' without further specifics).

children.description: MRI showing junctional zone thickening > 12 mm.

policy_citation.quote: MRI showing thickening of the junctional zone > 12 mm

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for pelvic MRI report (CPT 74181, 74182, 74183). Quote the junctional zone measurement in mm.

verdict_rubric.met: MRI report explicitly measures junctional zone >12 mm.
verdict_rubric.unclear: MRI mentioned but JZ measurement missing.

children.description: Nonmalignant cervical cytology (Pap smear) if cervix is present.

policy_citation.quote: Nonmalignant cervical cytology, if cervix is present

evaluation.extraction_hints: Pap smear (CPT 88142/88175). NILM/NEGATIVE result. If prior supracervical hyst, no cervix.

children.description: Negative preoperative pregnancy test (unless postmenopausal or previously sterilized).

policy_citation.quote: Negative preoperative pregnancy test

evaluation.extraction_hints: Negative hCG OR postmenopausal OR prior tubal ligation/sterilization (CPT 58600/58615/58671). Age >55 usually postmenopausal.

verdict_rubric.met: Negative hCG OR documented postmenopausal OR documented prior sterilization.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Reproductive status implied but not explicit.
